sections.title: Short title, commencement and application
sections.text: (1) This Act may be called the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. (2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
sections.simplified_explanation: This section names the law and states it will apply when the government announces a date.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.text: In this Sanhita, unless the context otherwise requires,— (1) 'act' denotes as well a series of acts as a single act...
sections.simplified_explanation: This section defines common words used throughout the law.

sections.title: Murder
sections.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
sections.simplified_explanation: The punishment for murder is death or life in prison, plus a fine.

sections.title: Short title
sections.text: This Act may be called the Indian Contract Act, 1872.

sections.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
sections.text: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive, from the party who has broken the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby, which naturally arose in the usual course of things from such breach, or which the parties knew, when they made the contract, to be likely to result from the breach of it.
sections.simplified_explanation: If someone breaks a contract, they have to pay the other person for the money they lost because of it.
